question: does the headline 4.30x depend on the synthetic economics?
method: re-evaluate the same agent portfolio and all three baselines with patched engine constants (margin level, SLA revenue multipliers, SLA penalty multiplier)
findings: the net-value ratio is invariant to the margin LEVEL (4.30x at 1/3x, 1x and 3x margin): the same prices scale agent and baselines together
the physical ratio (contract-compliant MW-months, 2490.6 vs 651.3 = 3.82x) is completely price-independent
the only sensitivity found is to the SLA premium spread: flattening it from 1.25/1.00/0.80 to 1.10/1.00/0.95 moves the ratio to 4.04x, and it stays above 4x even with a 2x penalty
what DOES rest on assumptions is the absolute dollar level ($279.9M), not the ratio
